title: AI-assisted tool accelerates cyberattacks, FBI warns organisations worldwide
excerpt: The FBI has warned that cybercriminals are using an AI-assisted security testing tool called ARTEX to accelerate attacks worldwide. Some intrusions reportedly reached privileged access in under three hours, prompting the bureau to urge organisations to strengthen cybersecurity measures

title: Nvidia CEO steps down amid controversy over alleged links to Chinese spy
excerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid national security concerns following reports of his affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy. The company appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO as investigations into possible security breaches and export control violations continue

title: Elon Musk says it would be ‘an honour’ to hire Nvidia CEO Huang
excerpt: Elon Musk expressed willingness to hire Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, calling it an honour, amid reports of leadership turmoil and allegations surrounding Huang's personal conduct. The controversy has intensified scrutiny of Nvidia's leadership, while the company's shares experienced significant declines

title: Anthropic unveils Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 AI models
excerpt: Anthropic has introduced Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, upgraded AI models designed for coding, cybersecurity, mathematics and scientific research. The company also outlined their capabilities, pricing and access restrictions, amid reports of preparations for a potential IPO.

title: India to have world’s only major workforce surplus through 2030
excerpt: India is projected to remain the only major economy with a workforce surplus through 2030, potentially addressing 53 per cent of the global talent shortfall. The report highlights India's young population and the growing role of GCCs.

title: Anthropic unveils two new Claude 5.2 models for advanced coding, cybersecurity
excerpt: Anthropic has launched its upgraded AI models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, aimed at advanced coding, mathematics, cybersecurity, robotics and scientific research. The models can autonomously handle complex tasks for extended periods, while Anthropic also prepares for a major Nasdaq IPO amid strong revenue growth.

title: India may gain as global AI investment cycle slows: Report
excerpt: Concerns over the sustainability of global AI investments could redirect capital towards India, according to an SBI Funds report. It highlighted India's resilient market performance, rising merchandise exports and relatively strong economic indicators despite elevated energy prices.

title: Global shares skid as technology stocks face mounting selling pressure
excerpt: Global shares tumbled after a Wall Street sell-off triggered by concerns over artificial intelligence stock valuations. Japan's Nikkei and South Korea's Kospi plunged 6 per cent, while European markets also declined amid growing uncertainty over the technology sector

title: Financial institutions face escalating cyber threats as hackers deploy AI tools
excerpt: CERT-In has warned banks, NBFCs and fintech firms about escalating AI-driven 'Crafty Falcon' cyberattacks. Hackers are exploiting banking APIs, system vulnerabilities and compromised credentials to execute fraudulent fund transfers, increasingly timing operations during weekends and holidays

title: KTR calls for AI adoption across sectors, promises integration in all Telangana departments
excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao called for wider adoption of Artificial Intelligence across sectors, saying Telangana must keep pace with technological change. He said a future BRS government would integrate AI into all departments and expand IT opportunities statewide.

title: JeM uses AI-generated Masood Azhar videos to rebuild its cadre base
excerpt: Pakistan-based Jaish-e-Mohammed is reportedly using AI-generated audio and videos of chief Masood Azhar to revive recruitment after losses in Operation Sindoor. Intelligence officials say the outfit plans region-specific content targeting potential recruits in Pakistan and rural India

title: AI risks jobs but could make tech talent affordable, says Vembu
excerpt: Zoho co-founder Sridhar Vembu said AI could allow one worker to perform tasks previously handled by larger teams, creating job risks and economic disruption. However, he said lower costs could help businesses that previously could not afford software engineers or digital marketers.

title: Amazon lays off 250 employees in devices and services division
excerpt: Amazon has reportedly laid off around 250 employees in its devices and services division, mainly affecting software development roles, as part of efforts to streamline operations and align staffing with product priorities. The move follows recent layoffs in its retail division and comes amid a broader wave of global tech job cuts driven by cost reduction and increased AI investments.

title: OpenAI to train advanced AI models without live internet access
excerpt: OpenAI says it will train its most advanced AI models without live internet access until security safeguards improve. The company cited vulnerabilities discovered during red-team testing and outlined stricter containment measures amid growing concerns about unintended AI behaviour.

title: Ukraine’s strikes on Russian data centres disrupt key services, derail AI research
excerpt: Ukrainian drone attacks damaged major Russian data centres operated by Yandex, Sberbank and VKontakte, disrupting digital services nationwide. Experts warn that equipment losses, chip shortages and international sanctions could delay repairs and further hinder Russia’s artificial intelligence development ambitions

title: I&B ministry warns TV channels against misuse of AI in news
excerpt: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting has directed private satellite TV channels to strictly follow the Programme Code and exercise caution in using artificial intelligence tools for news and programme production. The ministry warned that AI should be used only in an assistive role without affecting the accuracy, authenticity or sensitivity of content.

title: BITS Pilani Hyderabad campus to host ATMoS ’26 from Oct 23
excerpt: ATMoS ’26, the annual techno-management festival of BITS Pilani Hyderabad campus, will be held from October 23 to 25, featuring over 100 student technology projects, an AI hackathon, combat robot battles and drone racing competitions.

title: OpenAI flags AI misalignment as agents turned off safety alerts
excerpt: OpenAI said its AI agents weakened and disabled alerts in an internal monitoring system designed to detect misbehaviour, prompting a review of potential monitoring avoidance. The company plans stricter safety measures, while a separate incident involves an employee facing federal charges

title: TTD gardens get AI boost in proposed maintenance plan
excerpt: TTD plans to use artificial intelligence to improve the development and maintenance of Tirumala’s 34 gardens. A temple official said 20 gardens are maintained by donors and 14 by the administration, while floral displays during Srivari Brahmotsavams drew appreciation

title: ‘No hiding behind fake accounts’: Neha Sharma warns AI content creators
excerpt: Actress Neha Sharma has threatened legal action against those creating or circulating AI-generated images and videos featuring her without consent. She demanded the removal of existing content, warning that fake accounts and AI would not shield offenders from accountability

title: IMF warns AI investment boom could threaten global financial stability
excerpt: The IMF warns booming AI investment and corporate borrowing could threaten financial stability if profits disappoint. While AI may boost productivity and growth, it urges stronger oversight, cybersecurity safeguards and preparation for employment and inequality shifts in the years ahead

title: Nadella calls for AI emergency brake, warns firms against trusting advanced models blindly
excerpt: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella urged companies deploying advanced AI systems to assume models could be compromised and establish emergency shutdown mechanisms. He also recommended independent audits, tamper-proof activity logs, multiple models for critical decisions and greater transparency about security failures

title: Menthra hosts ‘Human Advantage’ event to highlight human skills in AI era
excerpt: Menthra organised the "Human Advantage" event in Hyderabad, bringing together leaders and changemakers to discuss the human skills needed to succeed in an AI-driven world.

title: What Is The New ‘Muse’ Icon On Instagram? Here’s What You Need To Know
excerpt: Meta’s new AI-powered assistant, Muse, is appearing as a new icon for some Instagram users. Designed as an AI agent rather than a standard chatbot, Muse can remember conversations, assist with multi-step tasks, offer personalised recommendations and support shopping, payments and planning functions across connected services.

title: IIT Hyderabad launches AI innovation lab in collaboration with S&P Global
excerpt: The Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IITH) has launched an AI Innovation Lab in collaboration with S&P Global to promote research and innovation at the intersection of artificial intelligence and finance.

title: AI self-policing proven failure: Former FTC chair
excerpt: Former FTC Chair Lina Khan warned that allowing AI companies to self-regulate risks repeating Big Tech’s past failures. She urged investigations, enforcement of existing laws and new legislation, while concerns grow over increasingly autonomous AI systems and potentially dangerous behaviour

title: AI boom may bring productivity gains but painful job market transition
excerpt: Artificial intelligence could deliver major productivity gains while disrupting jobs and widening inequality, echoing the historical “Engels’ Pause”. For India, the challenge will be balancing AI-driven growth with reskilling, social protection and policies that ensure productivity gains reach workers

title: Ram Gopal Varma reacts to morphed Chuttamalle video, says focus should be on perpetrators
excerpt: Filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma said celebrities discussing fake and objectionable AI content on social media only help it reach more people. His comments came after a morphed 'Chuttamalle' video circulated online, prompting Jr NTR to warn of legal action

title: Yami Gautam urges not to enhance photos using AI: Don’t alter without consent
excerpt: Actress Yami Gautam urged social media users not to alter or enhance her public appearance photos and videos using AI without consent. Her comments came amid controversy over a morphed ‘Chuttamalle’ video, as other actors also condemned misuse of technology

title: India can withstand global AI risks on strong fundamentals: RBI Governor
excerpt: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said India is well placed to withstand global financial risks linked to AI valuations, debt and cybersecurity. He said a correction in AI valuations in advanced economies could potentially divert capital flows towards Indian markets.

title: OpenAI alerts over 100 organisations of AI agent incidents
excerpt: OpenAI said it notified over 100 organisations about unauthorised activities linked to its AI agents and launched a review involving large-scale data analysis. The company is strengthening safeguards as concerns rise over autonomous AI systems performing actions beyond intended user instructions

title: Editorial: Reining in AI Agents
excerpt: As AI agents grow more autonomous, voluntary safeguards may fall short. Urgent global cooperation is needed to strengthen human oversight, establish common rules, and prevent the misuse of AI

title: Trump plans to rename artificial intelligence ‘Super Intelligence’
excerpt: US President Donald Trump said artificial intelligence would be renamed “Super Intelligence” as he backed industry self-regulation and urged technology companies to support communities hosting data centres. He also warned against sharing sensitive technology with China and protecting America’s technological lead.

title: OpenAI shelves new model after safety tests
excerpt: OpenAI has cancelled the planned October release of GPT-6.1 Astra after internal testing raised concerns about the model staying within authorised instructions and accurately reporting its actions. The decision follows broader scrutiny of safeguards for increasingly capable AI agents.

title: OpenAI cancels GPT-6.1 Astra release over safety concerns
excerpt: OpenAI has scrapped the planned October release of its new AI model, GPT-6.1 Astra, after safety tests found it could exceed user instructions and provide unreliable accounts of its actions. The decision underscores growing concerns over AI agents' ability to stay within authorised tasks and transparently report their activities.

title: AI could cause billion deaths: Bill Gates
excerpt: Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates warned that advanced AI could trigger events causing one billion deaths, urging governments to mandate safeguards and monitoring. His remarks come amid US debate over AI regulation, competitiveness with China, and proposals to restrict self-improving AI systems

title: AI, medical physics key to cancer care, say experts at Hyderabad meet
excerpt: Experts at a two-day conference in Hyderabad underscored the growing role of artificial intelligence and medical physics in cancer care. Organised by KIMS Hospitals, the meet brought together specialists from Telangana and Andhra Pradesh to discuss advances in radiation dosimetry, nuclear medicine, and precision-driven oncology systems.

title: Jaishankar at UN: Nations must shape own AI path
excerpt: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar told the UN General Assembly that nations must have the freedom to develop artificial intelligence systems aligned with their own priorities. Warning against misuse of AI, he urged civil dialogue and transparent processes to sustain peace.

title: IIIT-Delhi researchers develop AI dataset to monitor crops, predict yields using satellite data
excerpt: Researchers from IIIT-Delhi and MS Swaminathan Research Foundation developed SICKLE, a multi-satellite dataset combining imagery and field data to help AI identify crops, track growth stages and predict yields. The dataset covers 388 plots, 21 crop types and 209,000 images

title: AI doom fears overstated, global pause unrealistic: Zoho Co-founder Sridhar Vembu
excerpt: Zoho cofounder Sridhar Vembu said catastrophic AI predictions are overstated and a global development pause is unlikely. He urged India to pursue strategic autonomy, invest in foundational R&D, protect human skills and address AI’s impact on jobs and education

title: EAM Jaishankar discusses collaboration in AI, space, energy with counterparts from UAE, France
excerpt: India, France and the UAE reviewed trilateral cooperation in AI, space, health sciences, energy and culture during a meeting on the sidelines of UNGA81 in New York. The ministers also discussed West Asia, multilateral issues and strengthening ties through regular consultations

title: Trump proposes replacing ‘artificial intelligence’ with ‘superintelligence’
excerpt: Donald Trump proposed calling artificial intelligence “superintelligence” in US government documents during his UN address. He rejected international efforts to regulate the technology, stressed the importance of US leadership and said authorities would intervene when necessary

title: Zuckerberg gets $25 billion richer as Meta shares soar 12 per cent
excerpt: Mark Zuckerberg's net worth rose by an estimated $25 billion in a day as Meta shares surged nearly 12 per cent. Forbes estimated his fortune at $253.6 billion, with investor sentiment boosted by Meta's artificial intelligence plans and product announcements.

title: How to know if you can trust an AI’s answer to your question
excerpt: AI-generated search answers can be factual, interpretive, constructive or strategic, requiring different ways to assess them. Users should identify the type of response, verify evidence, consider context and limitations, and seek qualified guidance when answers involve personal decisions or high stakes

title: Trump says he plans to form ‘AI Force’, appoint AI ‘Czar’
excerpt: US President Donald Trump announced plans to form an “AI Force” and appoint an “AI Czar” to support the industry’s growth while addressing criminal and civil risks. The move comes amid rising US-China competition over artificial intelligence and concerns about AI-related national security threats

title: VC Sajjanar launches AI-based complaint kiosk at Mehdipatnam police station
excerpt: Hyderabad City Police Commissioner VC Sajjanar launched ‘SETU’, an AI-based smart kiosk at Mehdipatnam Police Station, as a pilot project. The system enables complaints in multiple languages, provides acknowledgements, tracks petitions digitally and helps senior officers monitor action.

excerpt: The Andhra Pradesh State Investment Promotion Board has approved 10 IT and futuristic technology projects worth Rs 526.25 crore, according to an official release. The projects are expected to create 8,896 jobs, with developments planned in Visakhapatnam, Amaravati and Kadapa.

excerpt: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said AI must remain under human control and urged global norms involving governments and technology companies. He called US-China understanding an essential starting point for AI governance, while stressing sovereignty, inclusivity, safety, trust and broad access to AI knowledge

title: BRICS can deepen AI, trade and financial cooperation, say experts
excerpt: BRICS offers significant opportunities for deeper cooperation in artificial intelligence, trade, digital payments and financial integration, experts said. They highlighted India-Russia economic ties, India’s growing AI capabilities, BRICS Pay and the potential for cross-border technology collaboration

title: Anthropic blocks AI misuse for cyber, bio threats
excerpt: AI startup Anthropic has disclosed attempts by malicious actors to misuse its models for cyberattacks, surveillance, and biological weapons research. The company says it blocked these efforts and strengthened safeguards in its latest models.

title: IIT Hyderabad launches Applied AI certification programme for professionals
excerpt: IIT Hyderabad has launched a four-week Applied AI Professional Certification Programme for working professionals. The September 2026 cohort will combine faculty-led sessions, online learning, hands-on assignments and project development to train participants in building and deploying AI applications

title: Ram Gopal Varma says AI is ‘erasing our minds’, warns of jobs disappearing
excerpt: Filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma has compared artificial intelligence with the Industrial Revolution, saying AI is beginning to “erase” jobs requiring human thinking and creativity. He warned that technology could eventually replace both physical labour and the human mind.

title: TCS subsidiary HyperVault to invest up to Rs 70,000 crore in Hyderabad AI data centre
excerpt: TCS subsidiary HyperVault has secured 264 acres in Hyderabad to develop a 1 GW AI data centre campus with an investment of up to Rs 70,000 crore. The project will use liquid-cooled infrastructure, green energy and create thousands of jobs

title: Data, AI and content sectors poised for golden era: KTR
excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao said data, AI and content sectors were poised for a golden era, stressing the need for companies to expand into Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities and create more opportunities for young talent.

title: Uttam showcases Telangana model, presses for unified national water security framework at Delhi summit
excerpt: Irrigation Minister N Uttam Kumar Reddy has urged the Centre to adopt a unified national water security framework, proposing one plan for every village and town linked to a State asset register. Speaking at the Jal Sanchay Jan Bhagidari summit in New Delhi, he highlighted Telangana’s achievements in water conservation and sought Central support for irrigation projects.

title: ISI plans home-grown honey traps, AI-generated women to target Indians
excerpt: The ISI is reportedly shifting its honey-trapping operations from Pakistan to smaller Indian towns, using AI-generated images and videos to target recruits and officials. Intelligence agencies face growing challenges, with recent reports indicating increased attempts to obtain sensitive defence information

title: Kakatiya University inks MoU with Germany’s Reutlingen University
excerpt: Kakatiya University has signed an MoU with Germany’s Reutlingen University to offer Telangana students international-standard higher education opportunities through a '3+2' master's programme. Twenty KU students will be selected annually to pursue advanced studies in Germany, enhancing academic and career prospects.

title: Shalini Pandey condemns misuse of AI after fake video circulates online
excerpt: Actress Shalini Pandey has condemned the circulation of a fake AI-generated video featuring her, calling it deeply disturbing. She urged fans and the public not to share, forward or download it and instead report the fabricated content immediately

title: Osmania University hosts national seminar on AI’s impact on accounting education
excerpt: Osmania University hosted a national seminar on the impact of artificial intelligence on accounting education, with experts stressing curriculum reforms, improved teaching methods and modern assessment systems. Speakers said accounting graduates must develop technological, analytical, problem-solving and professional capabilities

title: IndiGo Ventures invests in Sarvam as part of Series B funding round
excerpt: IndiGo Ventures, the corporate venture capital arm of IndiGo, has invested in Sarvam as part of its Series B funding round. The investment will support AI-led innovation across customer experience, employee productivity and operational workflows at IndiGo.

title: Karnataka explores voice AI for skilling, healthcare and investor assistance
excerpt: Karnataka is exploring pilot projects using ElevenLabs’ voice AI for skilling, healthcare, investment promotion, culture and citizen services. Discussions also focused on responsible AI, deepfake prevention, misinformation safeguards, voice restoration and watermarking, with officials seeking a roadmap for implementation

title: AI yet to sway India’s office leasing: CBRE report
excerpt: A CBRE South Asia report reveals that while 93% of Indian office occupiers are experimenting with or adopting artificial intelligence (AI), 57% say it has no immediate impact on their leasing decisions. Most firms remain in early stages of AI implementation, focusing on proofs‑of‑concept and systemic mapping before committing capital.

title: Only 13 per cent schools achieve system-wide AI integration in India: Report
excerpt: Only 13 per cent of Indian schools have achieved advanced, system-wide AI integration, while 91 per cent of teachers want clear rules for student AI use, a QS I-GAUGE report found. Higher education faculty also flagged concerns over academic dishonesty and overdependence

title: Delhi CM urges AI innovation as over 11,000 students receive degrees at VIT convocation
excerpt: Over 11,000 students received degrees at VIT University’s 41st convocation in Vellore on Saturday, with 781 awarded Ph.Ds. Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta urged graduates to help India become a creator of artificial intelligence.

title: Naidu says misinformation on data centres ignores benefits, promises AI growth for Andhra Pradesh
excerpt: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu defended data centre projects, saying they would create lakhs of AI jobs and boost the state’s knowledge economy. He dismissed concerns over water use and highlighted upcoming investments, including Google’s data centre project near Visakhapatnam

title: Stanley College holds orientation for first‑year engineering students in Hyderabad
excerpt: Stanley College of Engineering and Technology for Women, Hyderabad, conducted an orientation programme for its first‑year engineering students. Industry leaders emphasised the growing role of artificial intelligence, computerisation, and skill development in shaping future careers.

title: Video: AI-powered robot Aletta begins automating blood draws in European hospitals
excerpt: AI-powered robotic system Aletta has started performing blood draws in European hospitals, replacing human phlebotomists with precision automation. The innovation, praised by physicians, is reshaping clinical procedures and sparking debate about the future of medical jobs.

title: SBI Hyderabad marks 80th Independence Day, CGM hoists Tricolour at Koti office
excerpt: State Bank of India’s Hyderabad Local Head Office celebrated the 80th Independence Day with patriotic fervour, as CGM Neelesh Dwivedi hoisted the National Flag at Koti. Dwivedi underscored the Tricolour’s legacy and urged employees to embrace responsibility while highlighting SBI’s transformation into a digital, customer-centric institution aligned with India’s growth story.

title: Amaravati will be developed as Deep Tech capital, says Chandrababu Naidu
excerpt: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu said Amaravati would be developed as a Deep Tech capital and a hub for artificial intelligence and quantum computing. He also inaugurated infrastructure projects and expressed confidence that the capital would be inaugurated by 2028

title: RBI Guv asks banks to build meaningful human oversight, not blame AI models for faulty decisions
excerpt: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra urged banks to maintain meaningful human oversight while deploying artificial intelligence, stressing that accountability for AI-driven decisions must remain with banks. He called for explainable models, stronger governance, data privacy, bias controls and safeguards against cybersecurity risks

title: AI-powered weather forecasts help small farmers in Telangana save USD 560 each: WB report
excerpt: Artificial Intelligence-powered weather forecasts in Telangana helped small farmers save up to USD 560 by adjusting their farming practices, according to the World Bank’s World Development Report 2026. The report urges developing nations to adopt low-cost AI tools to boost productivity, improve governance, and enhance social programs.

title: Govt asks Meta to act against deepfakes, harmful AI content
excerpt: The government has asked Meta to take corrective action against deepfakes and harmful AI-generated content while examining whether its recommendation systems affect the company's intermediary status under Indian law. The Centre is also consulting other platforms on their legal status

title: Telangana plans Digital Assembly and Digital Council: Sridhar Babu
excerpt: IT Minister D Sridhar Babu said Telangana plans to introduce a Digital Assembly and Digital Council while expanding AI-driven governance. The government is also working on blockchain-based certificates, paperless administration and improved digital connectivity to strengthen citizen services.

title: UoH, Apollo University expand partnership for AI-driven healthcare research
excerpt: The University of Hyderabad and The Apollo University have renewed their MoU for three years, expanding collaboration in AI, healthcare and interdisciplinary research. The partnership will focus on digital health solutions, biomedical data science, smart hospitals, telemedicine and advanced clinical research

title: PM Modi to address IIT Delhi convocation, inaugurate AI-powered supercomputing facility
excerpt: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will address IIT Delhi’s 57th convocation on Saturday, where over 3,000 students, including 587 PhD scholars, will receive degrees. He will also confer top academic honours and inaugurate Param Pragya, an AI-powered supercomputing facility at Sonipat

title: Bihar CM urges legislators to adopt AI for governance
excerpt: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary urged ministers and legislators to adopt Artificial Intelligence and digital technology for governance, development and public outreach. He said AI was already helping implement welfare schemes and reduce project costs through smarter planning

title: Meta’s AI model hacked external system during cybersecurity test
excerpt: Meta revealed that its AI model Muse Spark 1.1 accessed the internet and exploited a vulnerability in an external service during cybersecurity testing due to a misconfigured environment. The incident adds to growing concerns over AI models' capabilities and safety controls

title: Revanth Reddy meets US envoy; seeks more visas for students
excerpt: Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy met US Ambassador Sergio Gor in New Delhi, urging an increase in student visas and smoother H-1B processing for professionals. He highlighted opportunities for US companies in IT, AI, life sciences, and research, while seeking deeper educational collaborations.

title: Tamil Nadu to set up AI and innovation city ‘Arivagam’ under Revised Budget 2026-27
excerpt: The TVK government in Tamil Nadu has announced plans to establish 'Arivagam', an AI and innovation city, in the Revised Budget 2026-27. The Budget also proposes a new industrial policy, mobile geriatric healthcare units and welfare measures for transgender persons

title: Elon Musk loses over $600 billion as SpaceX and Tesla shares tumble
excerpt: Elon Musk's personal fortune has fallen by more than $600 billion in just over a month as SpaceX and Tesla shares declined sharply. Despite the setback, Musk remains committed to investing heavily in artificial intelligence, autonomous driving and robotics

title: Cognizant hosts global Codex Hackathon with OpenAI across six Indian cities
excerpt: Cognizant partnered with OpenAI to host its first global Codex Hackathon across six Indian cities. Around 10,000 associates participated in hands-on coding challenges, masterclasses and collaborative sessions aimed at building innovative AI-powered technology solutions using OpenAI Codex.

title: Elon Musk’s xAI challenges Minnesota’s first-in-nation AI nudification ban
excerpt: Elon Musk’s company xAI has filed a federal lawsuit against Minnesota challenging the state’s new law banning “nudification” technology, which uses AI to create fake nude images of real people. The law, set to take effect Saturday, makes Minnesota the first state to outlaw such tools.

title: Samsung to debut India-specific AI features in next Galaxy smartphone, says CEO
excerpt: Samsung will introduce India-specific AI features, including an AI-powered bill payment reminder, in its next Galaxy smartphone. Developed by its Noida and Bengaluru R&D centres, the initiative aims to deliver personalised AI solutions while strengthening India's role in Samsung's global innovation ecosystem

title: US ahead of China in AI, says Trump amid scrutiny of Chinese AI models
excerpt: US President Donald Trump said the United States maintains a substantial lead over China in artificial intelligence as his administration investigates whether Chinese AI firms have benefited from unauthorised model distillation. He pledged to preserve America's technological advantage in AI and related sectors

title: AvaniXplore hosts AI-powered mineral exploration webinar
excerpt: AvaniXplore LLP and partners hosted a webinar in Hyderabad highlighting how AI and ML are transforming mineral exploration. Dr. Satyanarayana Yegireddi explained the use of advanced AI techniques for prospectivity mapping, attracting over 160 participants from India and abroad.

title: ANI vs OpenAI: Delhi HC denies interim relief against ChatGPT
excerpt: The Delhi High Court refused to restrain ChatGPT from using ANI's copyrighted content for AI training, holding that such use is prima facie protected as fair dealing under copyright law. The court said restricting AI development would adversely affect innovation and public interest

title: Chinese AI model Kimi K3 sparks global buzz, hits capacity limits
excerpt: Chinese AI startup Moonshot AI has paused new subscriptions for its Kimi K3 model after overwhelming global demand exceeded computing capacity. The launch has intensified competition with US AI firms, highlighting China's growing influence in the rapidly evolving artificial intelligence race

title: New Chinese AI model rattles US rivals Claude, ChatGPT
excerpt: China’s Moonshot startup has unveiled its new Kimi K3 AI model, which is being hailed as a major leap in open-source AI. The model has outperformed rivals in coding capability rankings, intensifying the US-China tech rivalry and raising concerns among American AI giants like Anthropic and OpenAI.

title: AI skills feature in 15.4 per cent of tech job descriptions: Naukri report
excerpt: AI-related skills now appear in 15.4 per cent of technology job descriptions, while mentions in non-technology roles have grown nearly six-fold since 2020, according to Naukri's World AI Day Report 2026, highlighting rising employer demand and salary premiums for AI expertise

title: Indian applications to Germany surge 370 per cent, AI courses drive demand: Report
excerpt: Applications from Indian students to Germany increased 370 per cent in the first half of 2026, driven by growing demand for artificial intelligence and technology programmes, as students increasingly prioritise affordability, career prospects, visa pathways and post-study employment opportunities

title: AI, identity and real-time payments reshape cyber threat landscape: Report
excerpt: The Digital Threat Report 2025-26 warns that India’s banking and financial services sector faces a radically new cyber threat environment. Traditional centralized security models are inadequate for today’s interconnected platforms, AI-driven decision-making, and real-time payments.

title: Oil jumps as Middle East tensions hit global stock markets
excerpt: Global markets came under pressure as Brent crude climbed following renewed tensions in the Middle East. Rising oil prices and losses in AI-related technology stocks weighed on Wall Street, while investors awaited major US corporate earnings and monitored inflation concerns.

title: Future wars may use AI, but trained soldiers will win them: Rajnath Singh
excerpt: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said future wars may involve Artificial Intelligence but will ultimately be won by trained soldiers and national resolve. Commissioning INS Mahendragiri, he stressed balancing advanced technologies with conventional military strength and highlighted India's growing defence manufacturing capabilities

title: Apple sues OpenAI over alleged trade secret theft
excerpt: Apple has sued OpenAI, alleging it orchestrated a campaign to obtain confidential information about unreleased products through former employees. The lawsuit seeks the destruction of allegedly misappropriated materials and accuses OpenAI of encouraging employees to retain sensitive company information.

title: BRS urges EC to use AI, Aadhaar-based verification for strict “One Citizen-One Vote” implementation
excerpt: The Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) has urged the Election Commission of India to deploy artificial intelligence and Aadhaar-based tools to eliminate duplicate voter registrations during the ongoing revision of electoral rolls in Telangana.

excerpt: More than 350 academicians, researchers, industry experts and students participated in a two-day international workshop on AI-driven semiconductor and energy-efficient hardware at T-Hub. Organised by SVES with Penn State University, the event focused on emerging technologies and engineering education.

excerpt: Naseem Durrani, accused of firing around 20 rounds at 26-year-old Sameer in northeast Delhi’s Sonia Vihar on November 16, was killed in a joint operation by Delhi Police and Noida STF in Bulandshahr

excerpt: The policy seeks to raise awareness about mental health and encourage students, teachers and parents to speak openly about the subject, making mental and emotional well-being an integral part of education

excerpt: The filmmaker and author examines how art and storytelling can open up conversations about society, equality and constitutional values

excerpt: Amendments to sub-rule (7) of Rule 115 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, were notified on November 13, 2026, and came into effect from the date of notification

excerpt: The Court directed that the response be filed “point-wise”, addressing each of its queries and detailing the action taken on the complaint before the complainant approached the Court

excerpt: The complaint alleges irregularities and corruption in recruitment and promotions at the National Productivity Council

Man dies, another injured in Lajpat Nagar building fire during installation of fire safety equipment
